purpose: A directory of Azion's products under a section title: one column per product group (Build, Store, Secure, Observe), each row an icon, a product name and one line about it, linking to that product. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'platform-directory', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — so its whole API is the props below, and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box` and `column-navigation` rather than owning any anatomy of its own.
useWhen: On Home, right under the hero, to show every product the platform offers at a glance.
On a solution, product or pricing page that repeats the full product map.
avoidWhen: For a handful of icon-led use cases → use `use-cases`.
For a site-wide navigation menu → use `navigation-menu`.
Inside another band's cell → compose `column-navigation` directly.
related: column-navigation` — the named navigation landmark whose columns and rows this band fills.
section-title` — the headline over the directory.
bestPractices: Keep to four groups; the directory fans out to four columns at the large breakpoint.
Give each item an `href`; an item without a title or a link is skipped, and a group left with no items is skipped too.
Set `ariaLabel` so the directory's navigation landmark is told apart from the site navigation.
